auto_borrow_active.meaning: Portfolio Margin enabled and an auto-borrow has triggered on the Vault's L1 account, so 0x811 borrow.value is positive while real net assets are unchanged
auto_borrow_active.checkpoint: before keeper surplus computation and settle

keeper_computes_surplus.meaning: the Operator keeper computes surplus() from on-chain state before proposing yield

principal_pool_before.meaning: USDC balance held in the Vault principal pool backing USDM before settle transfers yield out

principal_pool_after.meaning: USDC balance remaining in the Vault principal pool after settle transfers proposedYield to YieldEscrow

settle_transfer_amount.meaning: USDC amount transferred out of the principal pool by vault.settle(proposedYield) to YieldEscrow

principal_permanently_displaced.meaning: the USDC transferred out of the principal pool by settle is permanently displaced from the Vault's principal pool (not restored), as stated by the impact

assumptions: The principal pool balance is the USDC backing USDM and is the storage location whose depletion constitutes displacement.
settle_transfer_amount is the amount removed from the principal pool; the report does not give a numeric value for it.
Real net assets are unchanged by the auto-borrow, so any surplus above real net assets is phantom.

unresolved.description: The report does not state a numeric relation between principal_pool_before, principal_pool_after and settle_transfer_amount beyond the qualitative transfer; the conservation equation after == before - transfer is not explicitly written.

The report states principal is permanently displaced but gives no numeric or temporal definition of permanence; the plan carries it as the grounded bool principal_permanently_displaced rather than a numeric relation.

limitations: Only the principal-displacement impact is formalized; unbacked-yield and peg-solvency impacts are handled in separate passes.
The auto-borrow trigger is conditional and no concrete X is given; the plan keeps it symbolic.
Whether the keeper is buggy or rational is not resolved and is not encoded.
The Gate 3 phantom-surplus cap relation is not encoded in this conservation pattern; only the principal-pool displacement is formalized.
